provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Race for the Galaxy rules (Rio Grande Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: {n} VP in 1 and 5 chips nearby; 10 VP chips set aside for the final round
Each player takes a set of 7 action cards
Shuffle the 5 start worlds; deal 1 faceup to each player
steps.note: First game: start worlds 1-2, 1-3 or 1-4 by player count

steps.text: Shuffle the unused start worlds into the game cards; deal 6 each, discard 2 facedown
steps.note: First game: use the 4 numbered preset cards matching your start world instead

steps.text: Alpha Centauri in play: put a card from the supply facedown on it as its windfall good
Everyone secretly picks an action card and reveals together
